title: STALKER 2: Heart of Chornobyl receives its first major expansion 'Cost of Hope' in August
summary: The expansion includes 'dozens of hours' of additional content and will be released alongside a free update that improves the game's engine.

title: Cyan Worlds shows canceled prototype of a new Myst and confirms another game in the series is in development
summary: The studio released a teaser for 'Project Anglerfish' that will never be released, but assures they are working on a new Myst title.

title: Square Enix warns that remakes of Final Fantasy VI, VIII or IX could be longer than the FFVII trilogy
summary: Developers state that adapting these classics would require at least four or five installments, surpassing the length of the FFVII project.

title: PlayStation fans plan a one-week 'blackout' to protest against the end of physical discs
summary: The community organizes a boycott by turning off PS5s for a week to pressure Sony not to remove the disc drive in future consoles.

title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls concludes its open beta with Blade and Magik as favorites and criticism for PC performance
summary: The fighting game from Arc System Works had a mixed beta: great reception for the characters, but complaints about performance issues on PC that led to apologies from the developer.

title: Halo: Campaign Evolved now available for Xbox, sparks cultural controversy and praise for its graphics
summary: The Halo remake for Xbox tops the week's Japanese releases, while fans debate changes in narrative and visual quality, especially the water.

title: Xbox Network suffers a global outage that prevents playing digital and physical games
summary: Microsoft's service was offline for hours, affecting all players and generating criticism about the all-digital future.

title: A forgotten Steam game goes viral after being used to play Undertale in online multiplayer
summary: The developer is shocked to discover that their old game 'Crashphalt' now serves as the base for an Undertale multiplayer mod, with a 1,700% increase in players.

title: Former Dragon Age director calls EA a 'hedge fund with a video game hobby' and believes the series is dead
summary: Mark Darrah strongly criticizes EA and suggests that Dragon Age will not have more games after The Veilguard, although the problem is not that title.

title: Rockstar co-founder and Dan Houser defend physical discs in the debate about PlayStation's digital future
summary: Key industry figures, including Rockstar co-founder and GTA writer, urge companies to continue offering games in physical format if players demand it.

title: Pokémon Company will use facial recognition to combat card reselling
summary: The company plans to implement facial scanners to prevent resellers from hoarding products, according to press reports.

title: GTA 6 physical codes in Japan will expire and be region-locked
summary: Rockstar confirms that physical copies of Grand Theft Auto 6 in Japan will include temporary download codes and regional restrictions, generating confusion among players.

title: Microsoft gives away 13 Ubisoft games on PC to those who own them on Xbox
summary: Xbox users can claim Ubisoft titles for PC at no additional cost, taking advantage of a new platform benefit.

title: Shigeru Miyamoto: 'We don't start by asking what's trending' and defends the primacy of gameplay over hardware
summary: The iconic Nintendo designer states that the company focuses on offering unique experiences rather than following trends or competing on technical specifications.

title: User maps in Meccha Chameleon contain malware and official Discord server hacked
summary: The Steam bestseller game suffers a security crisis with malicious maps that infect players and an attack on its Discord community.

title: Jay and Silent Bob's Joint Venture announced, a farm simulator with marijuana cultivation
summary: Kevin Smith's famous characters star in a new agricultural simulation video game with an adult and comedic tone, where cannabis is planted and sold.

title: Marvel reduces to four movies in three years and reveals its schedule for phases 7 and 8
summary: The studio announces a decrease in production to prioritize quality, while detailing upcoming releases that include X-Men, Ghost Rider, and Black Panther 3.
